name: var_SN
math:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<model xmlns="http://www.cellml.org/cellml/2.0#" name="PhLynxComponent">
  <component name="SN_varicosity">
    <variable name="t" units="second" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="R" units="J_per_mol_K" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="F" units="C_per_mol" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="T" units="kelvin" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="N_avo" units="per_mol" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="epsilon_tau" units="second"/>
    <variable name="Vol" units="m3" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="c_ER_pre" units="dimensionless" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="c_ER" units="dimensionless" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="c_SL" units="dimensionless" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="c_bulk" units="dimensionless" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="V" units="milliV" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="E_Ca" units="milliV" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="cAMP" units="dimensionless" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="i_Ca_N" units="nanoA" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="g_CaN" units="microS" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="c_init" units="dimensionless" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="c" units="dimensionless" initial_value="c_init" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="hc_init" units="dimensionless" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="hc" units="dimensionless" initial_value="hc_init" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="c_inf" units="dimensionless" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="hc_inf" units="dimensionless" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="tau_c" units="millis" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="tau_hc" units="millis" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="tau_c_min" units="millis" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="tau_c_max" units="millis" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="V_mid_c" units="milliV" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="V_den_c" units="milliV" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="V_mid_hc" units="milliV" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="V_den_hc" units="milliV" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="Nai" units="millimolar" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="Nao" units="millimolar" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="i_NaCa" units="nanoA" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="k_NaCa" units="nanoA" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="alpha_NaCa" units="dimensionless" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="gamma_NaCa" units="dimensionless" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="Ksat" units="dimensionless" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="KmCa" units="millimolar" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="KmNai" units="millimolar" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="j_IP3" units="mol_per_s" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="k_IP3" units="m3_per_s" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="k_leak_Ca" units="m3_per_s" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="m_IP3_inf" units="dimensionless" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="h_IP3_init" units="dimensionless" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="h_IP3" units="dimensionless" initial_value="h_IP3_init" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="h_IP3_inf" units="dimensionless" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="tau_hIP3" units="millis" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="IP3" units="millimolar" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="a_2" units="per_millimolar" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="d_1" units="millimolar" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="d_2" units="millimolar" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="d_3" units="millimolar" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="d_5" units="millimolar" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="Q_2" units="millimolar" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="j_leak_Ca" units="mol_per_s" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="K_mf" units="millimolar" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="K_mr" units="millimolar" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="k_SERCA" units="mol_per_s" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="H_SERCA" units="dimensionless" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="j_SERCA" units="mol_per_s" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="j_RyR" units="mol_per_s" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="k_RyR" units="m3_per_s" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="c_RyR_inf" units="dimensionless" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="hc_RyR_inf" units="dimensionless" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="c_RyR" units="dimensionless" interface="public" initial_value="c_RyR_init"/><variable name="c_RyR_init" units="dimensionless" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="hc_RyR" units="dimensionless" interface="public" initial_value="hc_RyR_init"/><variable name="hc_RyR_init" units="dimensionless" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="Cai_RyR_mid" units="millimolar" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="Cai_RyR_den" units="millimolar" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="Ca_ER_RyR_mid" units="millimolar" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="Ca_ER_RyR_den" units="millimolar" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="Ca_ER_RyR_tau_mid" units="millimolar" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="Ca_ER_RyR_tau_den" units="millimolar" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="tau_c_RyR" units="millis" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="tau_hc_RyR" units="millis" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="Cai_init" units="millimolar" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="Cai" units="millimolar" initial_value="Cai_init" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="Ca_ER_init" units="millimolar" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="Ca_ER" units="millimolar" initial_value="Ca_ER_init" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="Cao" units="millimolar" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="j_Ca_N" units="mol_per_s" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="j_NaCa_Ca" units="mol_per_s" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="Ca_bulk" units="millimolar" initial_value="Cai_init" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="j_diffCa" units="mol_per_s" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="D_Ca" units="m3_per_s" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="j_diffCa_ER" units="mol_per_s" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="D_Ca_ER" units="m3_per_s" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="Ca_ER_pre" units="millimolar" initial_value="Ca_ER_init" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="B_Cai" units="millimolar" initial_value="B_Ca_init" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="B_Ca_init" units="millimolar" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="B_Ca_total" units="millimolar" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="CaB_Cai" units="millimolar" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="B_Ca_bulk" units="millimolar" initial_value="B_Ca_init" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="CaB_Ca_bulk" units="millimolar" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="B_Ca_ER_pre" units="millimolar" initial_value="B_Ca_init" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="CaB_Ca_ER_pre" units="millimolar" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="k_bind_Ca" units="per_millimolar_s" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="k_unbind_Ca" units="per_s" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="k_bind_Ca_ER" units="per_millimolar_s" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="k_unbind_Ca_ER" units="per_s" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="NE_init" units="millimolar" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="NE" units="millimolar" initial_value="NE_init" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="Cai_NE_base" units="millimolar" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="k_NE" units="per_s" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="k_NET" units="per_s" interface="public"/>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:cellml="http://www.cellml.org/cellml/2.0#">
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>c_bulk</ci>
        <apply>
          <minus/>
          <apply>
            <minus/>
            <apply>
              <minus/>
              <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">1</cn>
              <ci>c_SL</ci>
            </apply>
            <ci>c_ER</ci>
          </apply>
          <ci>c_ER_pre</ci>
        </apply>
      </apply>
    </math>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:cellml="http://www.cellml.org/cellml/2.0#">
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>E_Ca</ci>
        <apply>
          <times/>
          <apply>
            <divide/>
            <apply>
              <times/>
              <ci>R</ci>
              <ci>T</ci>
            </apply>
            <ci>F</ci>
          </apply>
          <apply>
            <ln/>
            <apply>
              <divide/>
              <ci>Cao</ci>
              <ci>Cai</ci>
            </apply>
          </apply>
          <cn cellml:units="milliV_per_V">1000</cn>
        </apply>
      </apply>
    </math>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:cellml="http://www.cellml.org/cellml/2.0#">
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>V_mid_hc</ci>
        <apply>
          <plus/>
          <ci>V_mid_c</ci>
          <cn cellml:units="milliV">11</cn>
        </apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>V_den_hc</ci>
        <ci>V_den_c</ci>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>c_inf</ci>
        <apply>
          <divide/>
          <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">1</cn>
          <apply>
            <plus/>
            <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">1</cn>
            <apply>
              <exp/>
              <apply>
                <divide/>
                <apply>
                  <minus/>
                  <apply>
                    <plus/>
                    <ci>V</ci>
                    <ci>V_mid_c</ci>
                  </apply>
                </apply>
                <ci>V_den_c</ci>
              </apply>
            </apply>
          </apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>hc_inf</ci>
        <apply>
          <divide/>
          <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">1</cn>
          <apply>
            <plus/>
            <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">1</cn>
            <apply>
              <exp/>
              <apply>
                <divide/>
                <apply>
                  <plus/>
                  <ci>V</ci>
                  <ci>V_mid_hc</ci>
                </apply>
                <ci>V_den_hc</ci>
              </apply>
            </apply>
          </apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>tau_c</ci>
        <apply>
          <plus/>
          <ci>tau_c_min</ci>
          <apply>
            <divide/>
            <apply>
              <minus/>
              <ci>tau_c_max</ci>
              <ci>tau_c_min</ci>
            </apply>
            <apply>
              <plus/>
              <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">1</cn>
              <apply>
                <exp/>
                <apply>
                  <divide/>
                  <apply>
                    <plus/>
                    <apply>
                      <minus/>
                      <ci>V_mid_c</ci>
                      <cn cellml:units="milliV">20</cn>
                    </apply>
                    <ci>V</ci>
                  </apply>
                  <ci>V_den_c</ci>
                </apply>
              </apply>
            </apply>
          </apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
      <!--+1{dimensionless}/(0.343{per_millis}*exp(0.0925{per_milliV}*V)+1.88{per_millis}*exp(-0.00732{per_milliV}*V));-->
      <!--+1{dimensionless}/(0.242{per_millis}*exp(0.145{per_milliV}*V)+0.0434{per_millis}*exp(-0.0201{per_milliV}*V));-->
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <apply>
          <diff/>
          <bvar>
            <ci>t</ci>
          </bvar>
          <ci>c</ci>
        </apply>
        <apply>
          <divide/>
          <apply>
            <minus/>
            <ci>c_inf</ci>
            <ci>c</ci>
          </apply>
          <apply>
            <plus/>
            <apply>
              <abs/>
              <apply>
                <divide/>
                <ci>tau_c</ci>
                <cn cellml:units="millis_per_s">1000</cn>
              </apply>
            </apply>
            <ci>epsilon_tau</ci>
          </apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <apply>
          <diff/>
          <bvar>
            <ci>t</ci>
          </bvar>
          <ci>hc</ci>
        </apply>
        <apply>
          <divide/>
          <apply>
            <minus/>
            <ci>hc_inf</ci>
            <ci>hc</ci>
          </apply>
          <apply>
            <plus/>
            <apply>
              <abs/>
              <apply>
                <divide/>
                <ci>tau_hc</ci>
                <cn cellml:units="millis_per_s">1000</cn>
              </apply>
            </apply>
            <ci>epsilon_tau</ci>
          </apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
      <!-- TODO Include cAMP effects?-->
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>i_Ca_N</ci>
        <apply>
          <times/>
          <ci>g_CaN</ci>
          <apply>
            <minus/>
            <ci>V</ci>
            <ci>E_Ca</ci>
          </apply>
          <apply>
            <power/>
            <ci>c</ci>
            <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">2</cn>
          </apply>
          <ci>hc</ci>
        </apply>
      </apply>
    </math>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:cellml="http://www.cellml.org/cellml/2.0#">
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>i_NaCa</ci>
        <apply>
          <divide/>
          <apply>
            <times/>
            <ci>k_NaCa</ci>
            <apply>
              <minus/>
              <apply>
                <times/>
                <apply>
                  <exp/>
                  <apply>
                    <divide/>
                    <apply>
                      <times/>
                      <ci>gamma_NaCa</ci>
                      <ci>V</ci>
                      <cn type="e-notation" cellml:units="V_per_milliV">1<sep/>-3</cn>
                      <ci>F</ci>
                    </apply>
                    <apply>
                      <times/>
                      <ci>R</ci>
                      <ci>T</ci>
                    </apply>
                  </apply>
                </apply>
                <apply>
                  <power/>
                  <ci>Nai</ci>
                  <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">3</cn>
                </apply>
                <ci>Cao</ci>
              </apply>
              <apply>
                <times/>
                <apply>
                  <exp/>
                  <apply>
                    <divide/>
                    <apply>
                      <times/>
                      <apply>
                        <minus/>
                        <ci>gamma_NaCa</ci>
                        <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">1</cn>
                      </apply>
                      <ci>V</ci>
                      <cn type="e-notation" cellml:units="V_per_milliV">1<sep/>-3</cn>
                      <ci>F</ci>
                    </apply>
                    <apply>
                      <times/>
                      <ci>R</ci>
                      <ci>T</ci>
                    </apply>
                  </apply>
                </apply>
                <apply>
                  <power/>
                  <ci>Nao</ci>
                  <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">3</cn>
                </apply>
                <ci>Cai</ci>
                <ci>alpha_NaCa</ci>
              </apply>
            </apply>
          </apply>
          <apply>
            <times/>
            <apply>
              <plus/>
              <apply>
                <power/>
                <ci>KmNai</ci>
                <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">3</cn>
              </apply>
              <apply>
                <power/>
                <ci>Nao</ci>
                <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">3</cn>
              </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
              <plus/>
              <ci>KmCa</ci>
              <ci>Cao</ci>
            </apply>
            <apply>
              <plus/>
              <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">1</cn>
              <apply>
                <times/>
                <ci>Ksat</ci>
                <apply>
                  <exp/>
                  <apply>
                    <divide/>
                    <apply>
                      <times/>
                      <apply>
                        <minus/>
                        <ci>gamma_NaCa</ci>
                        <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">1</cn>
                      </apply>
                      <ci>V</ci>
                      <cn type="e-notation" cellml:units="V_per_milliV">1<sep/>-3</cn>
                      <ci>F</ci>
                    </apply>
                    <apply>
                      <times/>
                      <ci>R</ci>
                      <ci>T</ci>
                    </apply>
                  </apply>
                </apply>
              </apply>
            </apply>
          </apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
    </math>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:cellml="http://www.cellml.org/cellml/2.0#">
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>m_IP3_inf</ci>
        <apply>
          <divide/>
          <apply>
            <times/>
            <apply>
              <divide/>
              <ci>IP3</ci>
              <apply>
                <plus/>
                <ci>IP3</ci>
                <ci>d_1</ci>
              </apply>
            </apply>
            <ci>Cai</ci>
          </apply>
          <apply>
            <plus/>
            <ci>Cai</ci>
            <ci>d_5</ci>
          </apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>Q_2</ci>
        <apply>
          <divide/>
          <apply>
            <times/>
            <ci>d_2</ci>
            <apply>
              <plus/>
              <ci>IP3</ci>
              <ci>d_1</ci>
            </apply>
          </apply>
          <apply>
            <plus/>
            <ci>IP3</ci>
            <ci>d_3</ci>
          </apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>tau_hIP3</ci>
        <apply>
          <divide/>
          <cn cellml:units="millis">1</cn>
          <apply>
            <times/>
            <ci>a_2</ci>
            <apply>
              <plus/>
              <ci>Q_2</ci>
              <ci>Cai</ci>
            </apply>
          </apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>h_IP3_inf</ci>
        <apply>
          <divide/>
          <ci>Q_2</ci>
          <apply>
            <plus/>
            <ci>Q_2</ci>
            <ci>Cai</ci>
          </apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <apply>
          <diff/>
          <bvar>
            <ci>t</ci>
          </bvar>
          <ci>h_IP3</ci>
        </apply>
        <apply>
          <divide/>
          <apply>
            <minus/>
            <ci>h_IP3_inf</ci>
            <ci>h_IP3</ci>
          </apply>
          <apply>
            <divide/>
            <ci>tau_hIP3</ci>
            <cn cellml:units="millis_per_s">1000</cn>
          </apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>j_IP3</ci>
        <apply>
          <times/>
          <apply>
            <minus/>
            <ci>k_IP3</ci>
          </apply>
          <apply>
            <power/>
            <ci>m_IP3_inf</ci>
            <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">3</cn>
          </apply>
          <apply>
            <power/>
            <ci>h_IP3</ci>
            <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">3</cn>
          </apply>
          <apply>
            <minus/>
            <ci>Cai</ci>
            <ci>Ca_ER</ci>
          </apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
    </math>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>j_leak_Ca</ci>
        <apply>
          <times/>
          <apply>
            <minus/>
            <ci>k_leak_Ca</ci>
          </apply>
          <apply>
            <minus/>
            <ci>Ca_bulk</ci>
            <ci>Ca_ER_pre</ci>
          </apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
    </math>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:cellml="http://www.cellml.org/cellml/2.0#">
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>j_SERCA</ci>
        <apply>
          <divide/>
          <apply>
            <times/>
            <apply>
              <minus/>
              <ci>k_SERCA</ci>
            </apply>
            <apply>
              <minus/>
              <apply>
                <power/>
                <apply>
                  <divide/>
                  <ci>Ca_bulk</ci>
                  <ci>K_mf</ci>
                </apply>
                <ci>H_SERCA</ci>
              </apply>
              <apply>
                <power/>
                <apply>
                  <divide/>
                  <ci>Ca_ER_pre</ci>
                  <ci>K_mr</ci>
                </apply>
                <ci>H_SERCA</ci>
              </apply>
            </apply>
          </apply>
          <apply>
            <plus/>
            <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">1</cn>
            <apply>
              <power/>
              <apply>
                <divide/>
                <ci>Ca_bulk</ci>
                <ci>K_mf</ci>
              </apply>
              <ci>H_SERCA</ci>
            </apply>
            <apply>
              <power/>
              <apply>
                <divide/>
                <ci>Ca_ER_pre</ci>
                <ci>K_mr</ci>
              </apply>
              <ci>H_SERCA</ci>
            </apply>
          </apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
    </math>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:cellml="http://www.cellml.org/cellml/2.0#">
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>c_RyR_inf</ci>
        <apply>
          <divide/>
          <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">1</cn>
          <apply>
            <plus/>
            <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">1</cn>
            <apply>
              <exp/>
              <apply>
                <divide/>
                <apply>
                  <minus/>
                  <apply>
                    <minus/>
                    <ci>Cai</ci>
                    <ci>Cai_RyR_mid</ci>
                  </apply>
                </apply>
                <ci>Cai_RyR_den</ci>
              </apply>
            </apply>
          </apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
      <!-- deactivated by Ca_ER decreasing, so also activated by Ca_ER-->
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>hc_RyR_inf</ci>
        <apply>
          <divide/>
          <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">1</cn>
          <apply>
            <plus/>
            <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">1</cn>
            <apply>
              <exp/>
              <apply>
                <divide/>
                <apply>
                  <minus/>
                  <apply>
                    <minus/>
                    <ci>Ca_ER</ci>
                    <ci>Ca_ER_RyR_mid</ci>
                  </apply>
                </apply>
                <ci>Ca_ER_RyR_den</ci>
              </apply>
            </apply>
          </apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <apply>
          <diff/>
          <bvar>
            <ci>t</ci>
          </bvar>
          <ci>c_RyR</ci>
        </apply>
        <apply>
          <divide/>
          <apply>
            <minus/>
            <ci>c_RyR_inf</ci>
            <ci>c_RyR</ci>
          </apply>
          <apply>
            <divide/>
            <ci>tau_c_RyR</ci>
            <cn cellml:units="millis_per_s">1000</cn>
          </apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
